fixes.target: diagram-9.1: Enclosure for drainage or water supply pipes
fixes.value: Section diagram of a vertical stack pipe with branch pipes inside an enclosure formed by a casing and a compartment wall, passing through an intermediate floor and compartment floors, labelled Stack pipe, Casing, Compartment wall, Enclosure, Branch pipe and Compartment floor. Side labels say the compartment floor and the intermediate floor are carried through to seal the enclosure and to provide fire-stopping between stack pipe and floor, and the key shows Casing, Enclosure, Fire-stopping around pipe and Compartment floor or wall. Printed notes say the enclosure should be bounded by a compartment wall or floor, an outside wall, an intermediate floor or a casing, have internal surfaces of class B-s3, d2 or better, have no access panel into a circulation space or bedroom, and be used only for drainage or water supply or vent pipes; the casing should be imperforate except for a pipe opening or access panel, not be of sheet metal and not have fire resistance less than E 30, and pipe openings should be as small as possible and fire-stopped around the pipe.
